checks: Infection, incubation, symptoms and infectiousness distinguished.
Infectious scope qualified rather than claiming all disease is microbial.
Viral particle and variable host sequence distinguished from bacterial fission.
WHO Ebola approved interventions kept virus-specific; post-recovery persistence qualified.
HIV versus AIDS, suppression versus cure and maintained sexual U=U scope retained.
Bacterial structure optional features, growth phases and axes/measurement distinctions checked.
Original invented doubling, density, rate and repeat calculations checked.
Practical control, fixed conditions, low-risk strain, closed-lid observation and zone limits recorded.
sourceAccessNotes: Selected WHO Ebola/HIV body passages read; no doses, protocols or clinical efficacy figures copied.
Nuffield direct open returned 403; selected indexed investigation and safety passages were accessible. No claim of a full direct-page review.
AQA school precautions used only as supporting practice; Pearson own specification controls scope. AQA universal anaerobic/no-growth wording not adopted.
OpenStax selected source passages checked. Universal reverse-transcription exclusivity and universal bacterial structures not adopted.
Original classroom examples and SVG, not source questions or experimental results.
